name: Rowan Segmunt
japaneseName: ロウアン・セグムント
description: Rowan Segmunt was a cynical Vollachian mercenary, former bodyguard to Emperor Vincent Vollachia, a Stargazer, and the father of First Divine General Cecilus Segmunt. Debuting during a failed loop in Arc 7, he reappeared as an undead corpse soldier in Arc 8, crossing blades with his son before imparting a final paternal lesson.
